target: Squared close-to-close daily logreturn at t+2; noisy second-moment proxy, not observed latent variance. Conditional variance interpretation requires negligible conditional mean.
forecast: Cutoff close t, target day t+2. No intermediate unknown return supplied. EWMA multi-step forecast held constant under its zero-drift variance-martingale assumption.
definitions: constant mean r2 January2 to December30 2022 frozen; rolling means20/60 r2; EWMA lambda.94 seed first60 r2 then chronological recursion; range20 mean log(H/L)^2/(4log2), diffusion/no-drift/no-jump assumptions not guaranteed. Variance floor1e-12, never optimize.
primary_metric: QLIKE=log(h)+y/h; finite for y=0; additive outcome-only constants omitted, can be negative. Lower better; never divide QLIKE values for percentage skill.
secondary_metric: MSE on squared return; not MAE on variance as primary, not direction or PnL
uncertainty: EWMA94,rolling60,range20 vs rolling20 paired QLIKE delta; circular bootstrap per cohort,14/60days,2000replicates,seed1701. All comparisons reported, exploratory, no multiplicity correction.
budget: Five prespecified forecasts per day, no fitted optimizer or grid. Two identical passes,1365 target days each. No selecting winner to deploy.
caveats: New risk question cannot rescue old directional scores
No intraday data: not HAR-RV or exact Corsi replication
QLIKE robustness requires proxy assumptions, not guaranteed for BTC or range estimator
All history inspected, no pristine holdout. Forecasting risk alone is not trading edge
No PnL USD20, VaR coverage claims, costs verified, live orders, paid inference
